"In colonial Calcutta, racial and social segregation created two distinct urban worlds. The 'White Town' was laid out around the newly constructed Fort William, with its vast open green esplanade (the Maidan), ensuring a clear firing field for military defense. In the White Town stood classical mansions with spacious verandas and manicured lawns, earning Calcutta the title 'City of Palaces'. "Although Harappa was the first site to be discovered, it was badly destroyed by brick-robbers.
